translations.web: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t pray for this people for their good.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not pray for the well-being of this people.
translations.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
